# IBKR TWS API

* The [TWS API Limitations](/docs/tws-api/doc/notes-limitations/limitations) page(s) have been updated to consolidate information and improve clarity in how the TWS and TWS API are related.
* The link to Trade Conditions has been removed from the [Receive Tick By Tick Data](/docs/tws-api/doc/md/live-ticks#receive-tick-data) page while the content is under internal review.
* [Error Codes](/docs/tws-api/doc/error-handling/error-codes) has been updated to include error code 0 and error code 10213 and their affiliated descriptions.
* [Event Contract Example](/docs/tws-api/doc/event-trading/contract-definition-discovery/forecast-ex-contract-example) has been updated to include references for `FORECASTX`, `KALSHI`, and `CME`.
* [Overnight Orders](/docs/tws-api/doc/orders/place-order/trading-the-overnight-session) has been updated to better reflect trading the `OVERNIGHT` and `OVERNIGHT+DAY` trading sessions.
* Combo orders in [Trigger Methods](/docs/tws-api/doc/orders/trigger-methods) have been updated to use `Bid/ask` trigger type instead of `Last` as the default.
